name: The Pedestal of Secrets
visual_description: A tower of etched stone, its four sides depicting creatures—some extinct, some imagined. It is a reliquary for memory, not truth.
meaning: The falseness of recorded history. The sensuality of myth.
existential_reflection: I carved these myths. Mizontresh let me. To lie is to shape time—to seduce the future. These were *never* records. They were erotic fictions to soothe my regret.
